correctness.rationale: The ordered pair and the set of attainable four-bit third-face comparisons give the complete one-move extension type: antisymmetry recovers equality, and recursive extension sets give ordinary first-order types without counting multiplicity. With a fixed first nonempty face, the five coordinate-pair classes are exhaustive under permutation and bit flips; bottom is a separate case, including at n=0. An independent exact replay (python3 /workspace/review_checks.py 1) unions local failure masks, retains at most four copies of each class (a witness for each false comparison suffices, and selected masks can be repeated), and compares the actual theory sets, not their hashes. It verified all dimensions 0–27, the six classes and both signatures in the separating sentence. For the infinite tail, after p total moves use threshold 3^(3-p), counting a bottom move towards p but not adding it to the coordinate tuples. In a matched parent cell of size at least 3t, copy all parts smaller than t and give t to every large part and any remainder to one large part. Every small parent is copied exactly. At the last move the nonempty cells match and determine every order comparison. This connects dimension 27 to all larger dimensions; the finite and infinite arguments together give cutoff 5, and 3^5+1=244 is sharp only inside this family. The replay is not a formal proof or a claim about higher quantifier ranks.

value.rationale: The exact threshold answers when pure inclusion logic of a fixed natural resource stops seeing a dimension that remains unbounded. It gives a complete reduction to six finite test structures for every rank-three sentence, with a separate sharp boundary witness; neither generic stabilization nor the face-count formula supplies this information. The scope is deliberately one family and one quantifier rank.
